_note: CHECKED-IN FIXTURES -- a stand-in for the M6.2 LLM provider, not inference. Each entry is what an LLM constrained to the trusted taxonomy in app/taxonomy.json is expected to return for that query. Matched on exact normalised query text only, and every intent served from here carries source='fixture' in the API response so the UI can label its provenance. These exist so the contextual-search experience can be built and reviewed before an API dependency is added; they are not a search feature and they generalise to nothing.
_why_these_queries: All three are cases scripts/measure_intent.py shows the embedding classifier cannot handle: it scores them below the MIN_SIMILARITY gate (rev-01, 0.543) or confidently picks the wrong category (sit-03 -> Organic Farming, sit-09 -> Digital Marketing). They are the demonstration of what the LLM provider has to add, chosen from measured failures rather than picked to look good.
_expanded_query_note: Deliberately null. app/intent.py derives it from the taxonomy's own vocabulary, so no retrieval-affecting text is hand-authored here.

intents.query: My company keeps getting suspicious emails and I want someone to make sure our employees don't fall for scams
intents.underlying_need: phishing protection and employee security-awareness training

intents.query: Our vegetables keep spoiling before they reach the shops
intents.underlying_need: temperature-controlled storage and refrigerated transport for perishable goods

intents.query: Our website goes down every time we get a rush of visitors
intents.underlying_need: scalable hosting infrastructure that absorbs traffic spikes
